title: Generic Form Component
description: Learn how to create a reusable generic form component.

data.text: A generic form component can handle any form structure while maintaining type safety for each field.

data.title: Generic Form
Render Props Pattern
data.text: Using render props (children as function) gives consumers full control over the form layout while maintaining type safety.

terms.definition: A pattern where a component receives a function as children
Operator that returns a union of an object's keys
Accessing a property type with T[K]

data.title: Form Design Principles
items: Keep the form logic separate from the UI
Use keyof to ensure only valid fields are updated

data.title: Exercise: Create a Typed Select Form
data.description: Extend the generic form to support select dropdowns.
steps: Create a SelectField component inside the form
Type options as { value: T[keyof T]; label: string }[]
Ensure handleChange works with select values
Add validation feedback for required fields
data.expectedOutcome: A generic form that supports text inputs and select dropdowns with full type safety.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Generic forms provide flexibility with type safety.
